It deliberately does not adopt the modern split or current modern item-section API. Its MAT_LEGACY_LIST/MAT_LEGACY_NAV_LIST are actual current MAT_LIST/MAT_NAV_LIST token identities and its module exports peer MatDividerModule. Packed metadata independently confirms each of eight declarations/exports, both peer token identities, and divider export. Current map and declaration confirm standalone modern classes; no modern component is the owned parent.
